Vedini Decorative Lotus Urli Bowl – 3.5 inch 4.5 inch and  5.5 Inch Metal Flower Urli for Floating Candles, Home Decor, Festivals & Pooja (Gold Finish)

Bring elegance and tradition to your home with the Vedini Metal Lotus Urli (5.5 Inch). Crafted from high-quality metal with a stunning gold finish, this decorative urli features a beautifully designed lotus petal border, ideal for floating candles, flowers, or potpourri. Perfect for festivals like Diwali, Navratri, weddings, housewarming, or daily pooja decor, this compact urli bowl adds a royal touch to any space.

Its size makes it ideal for tabletops, entrance areas, or living room corners. Use it as a centerpiece or spiritual decor item — an excellent gift for loved ones and devotees. Durable, rust-resistant, and easy to clean, this handcrafted piece complements both traditional and modern aesthetics.

🌟 Key Features:

  • Premium Quality: Made from durable metal with a rich golden finish.

  • Traditional Lotus Design: Intricately crafted petal detailing for a divine appeal.

  • Compact & Elegant: 5.5 inches in diameter – perfect for small spaces.

  • Multipurpose Use: Ideal for floating candles, water flowers, or potpourri.

  • Perfect for Gifting: Great for festive gifting, Diwali, weddings & housewarmings.

  • Handcrafted Finish: Adds ethnic charm to pooja setups or home interiors.

📐 Product Specifications:

  • Brand: Vedini

  • Product Name: Metal Lotus Urli Bowl

  • Material: Metal

  • Finish: Golden antique

  • Diameter: 3.5 inch 4.5 inch 5.5 Inch and 6.5 inch (approx)

  • Weight: Lightweight & portable

  • Made in India: Handcrafted by Indian artisans

  • Care Instructions: Wipe clean with dry cloth. Do not use harsh chemicals.
